newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Stockpile sells 9,884 short tons of aluminum.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Stockpile sells 9,884 short tons of aluminum.

text.p: U.S. Defense National Stockpile Center sold 9,884 short tons of aluminum for $13,339,732, the government's first sale from its light metal surplus.
The winning bidders were Alcoa, Metal Exchange, Glencore, Sumitomo Corp of America, Allied Deals, F&S International and Northwest Aluminum.
The winning bids ranged from a high of $1,453 per ton paid by Northwest, to a low of $1,225 per ton paid by Alcoa.
The next offering of aluminum is May 6.
